traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The giant’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spell, requiring no material components. * At will: alter self

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The wood giant makes two greatsword or two longbow
attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.
Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one
target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
